name: river-ford
title: Vadul râului (un râu verde prin pustiu)
units: engine units (figure 4.2 tall), three.js Y-up, +Z towards the usual camera

bank-left.note: on the left bank at the ford, facing the water (+X)

water-left.note: in the water near the left bank (shallow), facing across (+X)

ford-mid.note: the middle of the river at the ford: the water reaches the shins

water-right.note: in the water near the right bank, facing across (+X)

bank-right.note: on the right bank at the ford, facing on (+X)

path-left.note: on the footpath coming to the ford from the front left

path-right.note: on the footpath going on from the ford to the back right

offstage-left.note: out of frame on the left footpath (enter walking +X)

offstage-right.note: out of frame on the right footpath (enter walking -X)

downstream.note: on the water, downstream towards the camera (where things float away)

upstream.note: on the water, upstream far behind

wide.note: the river towards the back, both banks, the ford

ford.note: the ford from the front: people wading across

bank.note: the left bank where the path meets the water

notes: The river runs along Z (flowing towards +Z); people cross it along X at z = 2 (the ford), in profile to a +Z camera. The ground under the water is the walkable bed (the feet go down into the water, the water hides the shins); water.river is a separate, semi-transparent node (anim "flow": the ripples move downstream). Collision: col:palmN, col:reedsN, col:rockN, col:bushN.
